history: 1 (2026-11-16, platform 891a4135): the six items and weights of the review; dependency direction measured. No score of version 1 was stored.

2 (2026-11-16): cycle edges no longer count a way back that passes through the base or through a mixed package. Version 1 called plan -> lineage, lineage -> verification and owner -> coordination cycles; none of the three is imported back. Foundation's number is the same under both.
source: Owner 2026-11-16: one standard for every domain, kept in the system, scored on a schedule so a domain's number can be compared with its own earlier numbers. The items, weights and first data point (foundation, 54 of 100 at 80589bfb) are the independent review in the shared notes, brain/foundation-code-quality-review-2026-11-16.md section 9.
rules: A score always carries this version. Scores of different versions are not compared.
Changing an item, a weight, a measure or a formula raises the version.
An item is machine (computed by api/cmd/domainscore from the code) or review (a fixed brief, a fixed sample, an independent model). The two are reported apart and never added into one number.
An item this version does not yet measure is reported as unmeasured, never as zero and never as full marks.

items.label: Boundaries and dependency direction

measures.cycle_edges: direct imports (production code, api/cmd assembly roots left out) from a package of this domain to a package of a domain that itself reaches this domain through imports, by a path that does not pass through the default domain or through a 'mixed' package: the edges that make two domains one piece. A package with several domains counts as the domain 'mixed'; a package with no row counts as the default domain. An import of the default domain (the base every domain stands on) is never a cycle edge of the importer; an import of a 'mixed' package is one only for the base. Between two other domains a mutual dependency counts against both.
measures.wall: a test named in 'walls' below exists in the code and holds this domain's cycle edges to a list that only shrinks
measures.assigned_share: the share of this domain's production lines that are in packages whose row says status assigned (not default-maintainer, not without a row)

items.formula: direction 17 when cycle_edges is 0, otherwise 17 - ceil(cycle_edges / 2) and never under 11; plus 4 for the wall; plus 4 x assigned_share. One decimal.
items.fit: at 80589bfb foundation has 12 cycle edges, no wall and an assigned share of 0.45: 11 + 0 + 1.8 = 12.8, the review's 13.

measures.interface_calls: calls from other domains through an interface this domain declares
measures.concrete_calls: calls from other domains to methods of this domain's concrete types
measures.field_accesses: reads and writes by other domains of fields of this domain's structs
measures.registered_share: the share of what other domains use that is in a registered contract

measures.tables_written_by_others: tables this domain owns that another domain's package writes with its own SQL

measures.lint_per_kloc: golangci-lint findings per thousand production lines
measures.swallowed_errors: errors assigned to the blank identifier outside the allowed forms

measures.black_box_share: the share of top-level tests that are in an external _test package

measures.test_only_exports: exported functions and methods only tests call
